arxiv-1712-09617.description: Abstract Estimating ground state energies of local Hamiltonian models is a central problem in quantum physics. The question of whether a given local Hamiltonian is frustration-free , meaning the ground state is the simultaneous ground state of all local interaction terms, is known as the Quantum k k -SAT ( k k -QSAT) problem.

arxiv-2305-10625.creator: Arghya Datta, Subhrangshu Nandi, Jingcheng Xu, Greg Ver Steeg He Xie , Anoop Kumar , Aram Galstyan ,Amazon AlexaSeattle, WA, USA {argdatta, subhrn, gssteeg, hexie, anooamzn, argalsty} @amazon.com{xjc}@stat.wisc.edu
arxiv-2305-10625.description: Abstract Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) are becoming integral components of real world services relied upon by millions of users. Unfortunately, architects of these systems can find it difficult to ensure reliable performance as irrelevant details like random initialization can unexpectedly change the outputs of a trained system with potentially disastrous consequences.

arxiv-2310-00271.title: Virial Black Hole Mass Estimates of Quasars in the XQ-100 Legacy Survey 2022 Virial Black Hole Mass Estimates of Quasars in the XQ-100 Legacy Survey – 9

arxiv-2310-00271.description: Abstract The black hole (BH) mass and luminosity are key factors in determining how a quasar interacts with its environment. In this study, we utilise data from the European Southern Observatory Large Programme XQ-100, a high-quality sample of 100 X-shooter spectra of the most luminous quasars in the redshift range 3.5 < z < 4.5 3.5<z<4.

arxiv-2412-01440.title: DiffPatch: Generating Customizable Adversarial Patches using Diffusion Models
arxiv-2412-01440.creator: Zhixiang Wang, Xiaosen Wang, Bo Wang, Siheng Chen, Zhibo Wang, Xingjun Ma, Yu-Gang Jiang, [0.5em] Shanghai Key Lab of Intell. Info. Processing, School of CS, Fudan University
arxiv-2412-01440.description: Abstract Physical adversarial patches printed on clothing can enable individuals to evade person detectors, but most existing methods prioritize attack effectiveness over stealthiness, resulting in aesthetically unpleasing patches. While generative adversarial networks and diffusion models can produce more natural-looking patches, they often fail to balance stealthiness with attack effectiveness and lack flexibility for user customization.

arxiv-2501-03847.title: Diffusion as Shader: 3D-aware Video Diffusion for Versatile Video Generation Control
arxiv-2501-03847.creator: Zekai Gu, Rui Yan, Jiahao Lu, Peng Li, Zhiyang Dou, Chenyang Si, Zhen Dong, Qifeng Liu, Cheng Lin, Ziwei Liu, Wenping Wang, Yuan Liu
arxiv-2501-03847.description: Abstract . Diffusion models have demonstrated impressive performance in generating high-quality videos from text prompts or images. However, precise control over the video generation process—such as camera manipulation or content editing—remains a significant challenge. Existing methods for controlled video generation are typically limited to a single control type, lacking the flexibility to handle diverse control demands.

arxiv-2503-14706.title: Controlling Peak Sharpness in Multimodal Biomolecular Systems via the Chemical Fokker-Planck Equation
arxiv-2503-14706.creator: Taishi Kotsuka, Enoch Yeung
arxiv-2503-14706.description: Abstract Intracellular biomolecular systems exhibit intrinsic stochasticity due to low molecular copy numbers, leading to multimodal probability distributions that play a crucial role in probabilistic differentiation and cellular decision-making. Controlling the dispersion of multimodal probability distributions in biomolecular systems is critical for regulating stochastic behavior, robustness, and adaptability.

britannica-1911-oldenburg-grand-duchy.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-oldenburg-grand-duchy.description: Article 'Oldenburg (grand-duchy)' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 20), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. It consists of three widely separated portions of territory—(1) the duchy of Oldenburg, (2) the principality of Lübeck, and (3) the principality of Birkenfeld. It ranks tenth among the states of the German empire and has one vote in the Bundesrat (federal council) and three members in the Reichstag. The duchy of Oldenburg, comprising fully four-fifths of the entire area and population, lies between 52° 29′ and 53° 44′ N.

The present study collected helicosporous fungal samples from rotting tissues of Caryotamitis, Elaeisguineensis and E.oleifera in Xishuangbanna, Yunan Province, China.

pmc-11513541.title: Protocol for intracellular immunofluorescence measurements of latent HIV reactivation in a primary CD4+ T cell model
pmc-11513541.creator: Uri Mbonye, Anna Agaponova, Muda Yang, Jonathan Karn
pmc-11513541.description: SummaryInvestigating the molecular mechanisms of HIV latency reversal in a proper physiological context can only be done in primary cells. Here, we describe a primary T cell model of HIV latency and a reliable flow cytometry assay to measure latency reversal efficacy by dual immunofluorescence staining for Nef and Tat.

pmc-11658149.title: Characteristics, opportunities, and challenges of osteopathy (COCO) in the perceptions of osteopaths in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland: a metasynthesis
pmc-11658149.creator: Jonas Manschel, Jan Porthun, Jean Marie A. T. Beuckels, David Martin
pmc-11658149.description: BackgroundThe practice of osteopathy in Europe is not uniformly regulated. Even despite the topographical and cultural proximity, the regulation of the osteopathic profession also differs in the German-speaking countries. In contrast to Germany and Austria, both without any recognized osteopathic profession, Switzerland has already created legal regulations for the practice of osteopathy.

pmc-11697333.title: Integrating Biological Early Warning Systems with High-Resolution Online Chemical Monitoring in Wastewater Treatment Plants
pmc-11697333.creator: Ali Kizgin, Danina Schmidt, Julian Bosshard, Heinz Singer, Juliane Hollender, Eberhard Morgenroth, Cornelia Kienle, Miriam Langer
pmc-11697333.description: Detection of micropollutants (MPs) in wastewater effluents using traditional toxicity tests or chemical analysis with discrete samples is challenging due to concentration dynamics. This study evaluates a continuous monitoring approach for detecting MPs in wastewater effluents using a combination of biological early warning systems (BEWS).

pmc-12357474.creator: Chun-I Lee, Hsiu-Hui Chen, Shu-Hui Lin, Chun-Chia Huang, Pin-Yao Lin, Tsung-Hsien Lee, Ming-Jer Chen, Maw-Sheng Lee, Chien-Hong Chen

pmc-12694216.description: Background/Objectives: Breast milk lysozyme is crucial for infant intestinal health. The low breastfeeding rate has driven the investigation of alternatives like hen egg white lysozyme (HEWL) for infant formula supplementation. However, HEWL differs significantly from human lysozyme. pmc-13316267.description: BackgroundAdolescent pregnancy presents significant health challenges worldwide. Each year, millions of teenage girls in developing regions become pregnant. Adolescents in low socioeconomic situations, with limited education, or who face barriers to contraceptive access are more prone to unintended pregnancies.

pmc-13413100.description: Introduction: Transobturator midurethral slings (MUSs) are commonly used to treat female stress urinary incontinence (SUI). Despite their high success rates, postoperative complications such as voiding dysfunction (VD) and de novo overactive bladder (OAB) symptoms may affect quality of life (QoL).
